task: Harden shared exact-error diagnostic collection for CI security-audit and trusted release executor and feed normalized artifacts into Failure Intake without weakening failure behavior.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Trusted release executor exceptions and security-audit errors may be visible only in GitHub job logs, not in one machine-readable Failure Intake artifact or job summary. Issue #1018 requires exact error code, nested reason, job/step location, source SHA, and durable evidence without operator log mining or fail-open success.
observableOutcomes: On release executor failure the existing diagnostic wrapper emits the original nested machine code and reason, identifies the release job/step and retains the raw error with secrets redacted.
The executor workflow runs the wrapped command but retains the exact nonzero child exit status; an always-running intake step uploads machine-readable evidence.
Security audit failures and exhausted retry/network failures produce normalized machine diagnostics and Failure Intake artifacts in the separate security-audit job.
A focused regression covers nested RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_BLOCK with reason/error, fallback exception, secret scrubbing and exact nonzero exit code.
No reduction to Plan/Edit-Time/Truth/Lifecycle/Security gate checks and no duplicate executor or CI dispatch.
unresolvedRisks: Wrapper output buffering can hide progress for a long-running release driver or exhaust memory; prefer streamed forwarding with bounded error tail.
npm audit may report network failure and retry; intake must capture only final failure rather than the first transient attempt.
Workflow cleanup must not mask the primary command failure or unexpectedly report success.
Token-bearing stderr may leak to persisted diagnostic artifacts; redact known CI credentials.
Security audit job independence means the build job cannot ingest its local files; each job must publish its own artifact and Failure Intake.

in: Extend existing shared scripts/shoperation-command-diagnostic.mjs with streamed output, exact nested error extraction and bounded sanitized raw diagnostics.
Bind trusted release-unit-execution.yml driver invocation to that shared command diagnostic and post-failure intake/artifact upload.
Bind the independent ci.yml security-audit job to its own normalized command diagnostic, artifact and intake without changing retry outcome.
Extend tests/control-plane-diagnostic-coverage.test.ts with positive/negative exact diagnostic and workflow wiring assertions.
out: No edits to release-unit canonical state, existing receipts, immutable source, release authorization, CI gate thresholds, or merge policy.
No new separate generic diagnostic controller; reuse the existing command-diagnostic and Failure Intake v2.
No Builder, templates, storefront, customer, database or payments.
No background job or extra production deployment.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: False success or masked security/release failure threatens release correctness; implementation is observability only and must fail closed.

acceptanceCriteria: A nested release failure emits exact code and nested error in structured artifact and GitHub summary without manual log retrieval.
Security audit failure yields its final precise npm error after existing bounded retries; the job still fails.
Interrupted/external failure returns the child's original nonzero exit code and fallback normalized code if the exact code is absent.
Intake artifacts preserve source/run/gate and secret-free evidence, failure classification and provide a machine-localized code.
Complete CI checks (Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Risk, Tests, TypeScript, Build, Truth, Lifecycle) are unchanged and terminal PASS required before merging.
invariants: Exit code and gate decisions remain authoritative: diagnostics may never downgrade a failure to PASS.
No new release execution attempts, dispatches or material changes are caused by diagnostics.
Every diagnostic binds to exact source SHA, job/gate and original stable code when present.
Only the bounded declared files may change after Plan PASS.
forbiddenStates: Any failure is silently swallowed by cleanup or diagnostic parsing.
A GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN secret is stored in a public workflow artifact.
A network timeout is diagnosed as clean successful security audit.
A stale or foreign PR is authorized because diagnostics ran.
The first implementation edit precedes an exact-head Plan Before Code PASS.

failureModes: Release driver exits nonzero with nested JSON error; parser only stores generic RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_BLOCK.
npm audit network transient is retried then succeeds; stale failed diagnostics must not persist.
Job setup/checkout/install fails before diagnostic command; fallback step still emits step-localized evidence.
Child process sends >64 MB logs while workflow waits and old sync buffer overflows.
Error stderr contains GitHub token and leaks when copied verbatim.
Failure Intake itself throws and shadows original error.
edgeCases: Nested reason is an object with code and details while error is a string.
Unknown exception has no formal code.
Child exits by signal or cannot spawn.
Security npm audit returns high vulnerabilities or terminal network failure.
Workflow steps are skipped because preceding step failed.
Exact commit and GH run identity are available without logging secrets.

alternatives.summary: Extend existing shared command-diagnostic and wire two independent job failure surfaces.
alternatives.reason: One normalized command error implementation and existing Failure Intake preserve architecture and avoid two independent controllers.

alternatives.summary: Require operators to query GitHub job logs for nested exceptions.
alternatives.reason: Violates #1018 observable code requirement and leaves same failure.

alternatives.summary: New central GitHub workflow API polling service for every job.
alternatives.reason: Introduces unrelated permissions, eventual consistency and duplicate authority when job-local evidence is available.

specialistReviews.finding: The shared diagnostic wrapper already exists but does not cover all authoritative jobs.
specialistReviews.resolution: Extend existing wrapper, with job-local Failure Intake steps.

specialistReviews.finding: Persisting raw CLI stderr could leak GitHub credentials.
specialistReviews.resolution: Redact configured tokens from diagnostic and summary, retain original exit and exact error code, and avoid dumping all logs into artifacts.

specialistReviews.finding: Executor is a long-running side-effectful CLI; sync capture can mask progress and cannot alter state.
specialistReviews.resolution: Stream stdout/stderr with bounded capture and preserve exit code without dispatch/replay side effects.

specialistReviews.finding: Intake already accepts generic code and structured artifact; must favor exact structured detail.
specialistReviews.resolution: Prefer parsed nested stable code while retaining fallback only if exact code absent.

challenge.scenario: Nested error's stable code sits in result.reason.code, not outer Error prefix.
challenge.finding: Old wrapper can report generic RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_BLOCK.
challenge.resolution: Parse nested error JSON before regex and preserve both nested reason and original raw error sanitized.

challenge.scenario: Security audit retry 1 fails but retry 2 succeeds.
challenge.finding: First diagnostic artifact might remain FAILED.
challenge.resolution: Overwrite per-attempt report, publish intake only if final terminal job fails.

challenge.scenario: A blocked CI step prevents next steps, including diagnostic command.
challenge.resolution: Record fallback step name and failed outcome in always-running postflight without classifying a successful job as failed.

challenge.scenario: Executor issues GitHub remote side effects and then errors.
challenge.finding: Restart or retry by diagnostic wrapper could duplicate operations.
challenge.resolution: Never retry from wrapper; only record child nonzero outcome and let canonical release state control resumability.

challenge.scenario: Unexpected large child stdout buffers during long executor.
challenge.finding: Old spawnSync maxBuffer introduces diagnostic-induced failure.
challenge.resolution: Stream child logs and capture bounded tail only.
Redact exact tokens before persisting while leaving stable code and location intact.

challenge.scenario: An exact-code parser sees a stack trace with unrelated uppercase tokens and no valid nested error object.
challenge.finding: A broad regex can synthesize a false stable error code.
challenge.resolution: Prefer parsed structured release block or anchored `Error: <CODE>`; fall back to known gate code rather than unsafe pattern guesses.

challenge.scenario: An always-running failure-intake step runs after checkout/install has already failed.
challenge.finding: The script may be unavailable or locked dependencies absent.
challenge.resolution: Record failure step/outcome through job-local `always()` fallback with minimal Node runtime when repository is available; fail closed and retain original workflow job failure if unavailable.

proofPlan: Plan-only exact-head gate PASS before code; reconcile Atlas scope/negative knowledge rather than overriding.
Implement shared streaming nested-code parser, plus diagnostic wiring in two authoritative workflow jobs.
Run focused regression covering nested error, generic fallback, secret scrub, signal/exit and unaffected success.
Run Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental, tests/typecheck/build and complete Truth/Lifecycle on exact implementation SHA.
Review actual separate security and executor job artifacts from CI; do not close #1018 until evidence proves every claimed source.

requirements.requirement: A release executor failure emits exact nested machine code, reason, location and source/run bound artifact/summary without altering execution status.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No wrapped child error is converted to a successful exit.

requirements.requirement: A separate security audit job emits structured exact failure diagnostics and Failure Intake without weakening npm audit retry/fail rules.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Security audit nonzero failure still fails the entire security-audit job.

requirements.requirement: Normalize codes, locations, and sanitized raw errors without leaking credentials or creating a duplicate diagnostic authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No configured CI token is written to a diagnostic artifact or summary.

notes: Plan-only checkpoint: no implementation change may be authored until exact-head Plan Before Code succeeds.
Historical issue #1018. Existing generic command-diagnostic is canonical; do not add a competing second diagnostics engine.

Sentinel proof-semantics correction: guard registry lacks a 'security' or generic 'evidence' dimension; use accurately provable CAP-QUALITY status/evidence-scope/forbidden-state. The security-audit job itself remains mandatory CI evidence, not a fabricated extra guard capability.
